name: SmartRequestSystem – Customer Requests & Business Availability
author: Smart Request System

sections.description:
The only request system you need

Automate intake, approvals, and notifications — all within WordPress. Built on top of Directorist and FormGent for reliability, speed, and a seamless admin experience.

Key Features (FREE VERSION)

  • Integration with Directorist and FormGent
  • Easy setup to select directory type and form
  • Automatic or manual request approval
  • Admin-only request approval and rejection
  • Frontend displays only approved requests
  • Form field mapping for email and phone number
  • Expiration date support
  • Strict directory type validation
  • Centralized admin request listing page
  • Displays complete submitted form data
  • Connectivity check and rescan tool
  • Clean and user-friendly request layout
  • Lightweight and WordPress standards compliant

Key Features (PRO VERSION) (All features of the free version plus the below features)

  • Business update radius configuration (KM)
  • Location-based request matching (country)
  • Show or hide individual request fields
  • Advanced request filtering by form fields
  • Request activity and email logs
  • Custom email notifications with templates
  • Custom SMS notification system
  • Multiple templates per request status
  • Enhanced admin dashboard controls
  • Request history with timestamps and count
  • Developer hooks and filters
  • Priority premium support
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  4. Upload the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  5. After installation, click Activate to enable the plugin.
  6. Go to the plugin settings page from the WordPress admin menu to configure it.
  7. Ensure that Directorist and FormGent are installed and activated.
sections.faq:
Do I need Directorist and FormGent?

Yes, both plugins are required for the SmartRequestSystem – Customer Requests & Business Availability to function properly.

What PHP version is required?

A minimum PHP version of 7.2 is required.
